The '''''Scarab''-class starfighter''' was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] starfighter. It was the predecessor to the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighter]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ScarabClassGroup.jpg|thumb|left|A group of ''Scarab'' starfighters]]
The ''Scarab'' [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] had a flat body and two outrigger wings, each connected to the main fuselage by a pair of heavy struts. The wings would lock down against the body while in normal flight mode, and spring open to achieve fire capability and maximum maneuverability when in combat.

This multiple-purpose fighter could attack targets in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], within a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] atmosphere, or on the ground. Even though it lacked the agility of its successor, the ''Vulture''-class starfighter, the ''Scarab''-class was equipped with strong armor and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The ''Scarab'' featured a cockpit compartment and was normally piloted by a droid. It was also able to operate independently of a [[Droid control program|droid control]] unit, whereas the ''Vulture''s could not.

==History==
[[File:TwoScarabClass.jpg|thumb|left|One ''Scarab'' in normal flight mode and one in combat mode]]
''Scarab'' starfighters were tested by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] and the [[Karthakk system]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vana Sage]] was contracted to [[Skirmish at Eos|test the craft in battle]] before her contract was infringed. Though effective, the ''Scarab''s proved no match for the combined forces of [[Rhys Dallows]], Vana Sage and [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who helped slow the Federation's march on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].

Though supplanted by the ''Vulture''-class, ''Scarab''-class starfighters were still in use at least [[22 BBY/Legends|ten years later]]. They were also deployed in the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
Scarabs first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].
